runtime: Bun with Linux wordcraft-cli binary and filesystem
recovery_steps: Build a non-Workers Linux container from Dockerfile.wordcraft (test only)
Set a new strong MCP_TOKEN as host secret; never commit it
Start a test instance with localhost-only port and run GET /health and GET /selftest
Test initialize, tools/list, document creation, save, download and session isolation
Verify newest release asset and SHA256 before changing original_release
Put HTTPS + proper access control in front before any public exposure
security_warnings: Original gateway uses a token in URL path; prefer short-lived auth or header based tokens in future
Runtime archive download in legacy code does not verify SHA256; use checksum validation for production
Session files on /tmp are lost on redeploy
Migrating to Cloudflare Workers Free cannot run native executable
